title: ISO system of limits and fits (ISO-Passungen)
units: micrometres (um) in the tables; the lookup returns mm
notes: A fit callout is letter(s) + IT grade: 'H7' (hole, capital letter), 'g6' (shaft, small letter). '20 H7/g6' is a fit between a 20 H7 bore and a 20 g6 shaft.
Tolerance band width = IT grade value for the size range.
Shafts a..h: upper deviation es = fundamental deviation (<= 0), lower ei = es - IT.
Shafts k..zc: lower deviation ei = fundamental deviation (>= 0), upper es = ei + IT.
Holes A..H: lower deviation EI = -es of the same small letter (H: EI = 0), upper ES = EI + IT. Valid for F, G, H, E at all grades.
k: the fundamental deviation in the table applies for IT4..IT7; for other grades ei = 0.
Not included: hole letters K, M, N, P and above (they need the delta correction from ISO 286-1) and shafts r, s and above. The lookup reports these as unsupported instead of guessing.
Size ranges are 'over .. up to and including'. The model is always built at the nominal size; the deviations go into the report.

common_fits.H7/g6: sliding fit (Gleitsitz): parts move, small clearance
common_fits.H7/k6: transition fit (Uebergangssitz): hub on shaft, easy assembly
